description: Baileys bot: spare WhatsApp (+923703832506) sends Dogar Alpha Elite trade alerts ONLY to the main number +923001412943, polled from the dogar-alerts Worker queue.
name: spare-whatsapp-bot

scripts.self-test: node -e "const m=require('./bot.js');const a=require('assert');a.strictEqual(m.stripLinks('BUY https://x/y SL 1'),'BUY SL 1');a.strictEqual(m.assertQueuedJid('923001412943'),'923001412943@s.whatsapp.net');a.strictEqual(m.assertQueuedJid('923703832506'),'923703832506@s.whatsapp.net');a.throws(()=>m.assertQueuedJid('abc'),/refusing/);a.deepStrictEqual(m.fromStorable(m.toStorable({a:Buffer.from([1,2,3]),b:{c:Buffer.from('hi')}})),{a:Buffer.from([1,2,3]),b:{c:Buffer.from('hi')}});m.markSent('self-test-id');a.strictEqual(m.isRecentlySent('self-test-id'),true);a.strictEqual(m.ownNumberDigits({user:{id:'923703832506:12@s.whatsapp.net'}}),'923703832506');a.strictEqual(m.ownNumberDigits(null),null);a.strictEqual(m.isValidBotCommand('restart'),true);a.strictEqual(m.isValidBotCommand('STOP'),true);a.strictEqual(m.isValidBotCommand('explode'),false);console.log('SELF-TEST OK')"
